CRIMINAL PETITION No.2576 of 2023
DATE OF ORDER:30.03.2026
Between:
Kashamolla Santhosh Rao  ...Petitioner/Accused No.2 AND The State of Telangana,
rep. by its Public Prosecutor & another  ...Respondents  ORDER 1.
This Criminal Petition is filed under Section 482 of The Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short, 'Cr.P.C) seeking to quash the proceedings against the petitioner/accused No.2 in Crime No.278 of 2022, on the file of Khammam I Town Police Station, Khammam District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 409, 417, 420, 467, 471, 294(b), 506 read with 34 of IPC and Section 66(D) of Information Technology Act and Section 156(3) of IPC.

opennyai_summary.decision:
When the matter is taken up for hearing, the learned Additional Public Prosecutor has brought it to the notice of this Court that charge sheet has been filed during pendency of this case vide C.C.No.922 of 2025 and is pending before the Court of I Additional Junior Civil Judge -cum- Special Judicial Magistrate of First Class (Juvenile Court), Khammam.
3. In view of the changed circumstances, the cause in the Criminal Petition does not survive and the same has become infructuous.
